parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The current page number in paging.

parameters.name: ItemValue
parameters.description: The domain name value filter. Fuzzy match is supported.

parameters.name: ListId
parameters.description: The list ID. This is a unique business identifier used for policy references and CRUD operations.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in paging. Valid values: 1 to 1000.
